sponges text index | photo index Phylum Porifera Tangled sponge
Callyspongia samarensis*Family Callyspongiidae updated Oct 2016

Where seen? Appearing like a bunch of tangles, this sponge is sometimes seen on our Southern shores. Features: 15-20cm long, 1cm in diameter. A clump ‘stems’ flatttened, slender (0.5cm), long and sparsely branched, often in a tangle. Small regular holes along the length. Colours bluish to olive green and yellowish green.


Pulau Pawai, Dec 09**


Pulau Semakau, May 08**


Pulau Hantu, Jul 07

*Species are difficult to positively identify without close examination.
On this website, they are grouped by external features for convenience of display.
